standard_prerequisites.name: Nonsymmetric unital colored operads, CGWH spaces, CW products, Boardman-Vogt resolution, dendroidal trees and monadic bar realization
standard_prerequisites.statement: Original unital/nonsymmetric/C-colored and CW-in-each-color assumptions retained literally in the principal statement; all definitions and cited standard facts remain in the complete author context.
standard_prerequisites.use: Complete source-local horn, cylinder, reduction and bar-construction arguments included; no reconstruction of external cited background.

core_obligations: The author constructs compatible cellular higher operations by reducing decorated trees to local tree operads, filling inner and external dendroidal horns in the Boardman-Vogt cylinder, and pasting relative cellular approximations without changing prescribed objects. Two-sided monadic bar realization and a further horn filling produce strict CW rectification. Ordinary objectwise cellular approximation alone does not supply these coherent higher operations. The approximation and its rectification are bundled as one principal object.
